findings.title: No all-off start: negative-price storage plants ship plans 1.8-8.6 % worse than off; MPC masks most
findings.claim: On the 60 d0-grid cells summer_negative/summer_warm/*, production ships on 16 (every one a storage plant: valve-storage, wood, manual-valve-buffer, flow-setpoint-behind-valve; 0 of 12 plain) a space plan whose true objective exceeds the plan production's own _multi_start_minimize reaches from the all-off (lower-bound) start by 273-3204 objective units (1.8-7.4 % of the objective), heating an above-ceiling house 2.9-35.6 more degree-steps for 0.03-1.65 SEK of negative-price revenue; on the 60 flat-price twins the gap is 0. D0.M6: in a 24 h closed loop re-planned hourly (loop.py, plant == model, production's warm seed), the augmented arm (structured seeds incl. the lower bound) realises < 1 objective unit better on 12 of the 16 gap cells, 30-85 units better on 3 (all flow-setpoint-behind-valve) and 128 units worse on 1; mean realised gap 1.59 units/day, -3.95 with the most favourable cell dropped, energy money within 0.75 SEK/day either way: the shipped (published) plan is wrong, the realised loss is small and not robust.
findings.mechanism: Every production start set (_solve_space and the space-only path in optimizer.py: the guess, _price_ranked_start at the baseline/low/deep-low energy, headroom*0.5, the seed power) carries energy, and none is the lower bound. Through a buffer and mixing valve the room's response to pump power saturates: past a small threshold extra power no longer raises the room (the overshoot penalty is flat in power: J at 0.5x and 1.0x the shipped plan differ by 0.3 units, at 0.01x it is the off value), while the negative price keeps paying for more. Every start descends onto that plateau, so L-BFGS-B never sees the off basin the objective prefers by thousands of units. Masking: the shipped plan's heating sits after step 0 (step0_prod = 0 on every gap cell), so a re-plan an hour later re-derives it and the closed loop on most cells coasts at the off trajectory anyway.

findings.title: _terminal_cost docstring: no credit breaches the tail floor; at any learnable weight it never does
findings.claim: With HeatPumpOptimizer._terminal_cost zeroed, the shipped plan's last-2-h degree-steps below the per-step comfort floor are no worse than with it on 0 of 40 committed cells at the default comfort_weight (5.0) and 0 of 40 at the comfort learner's minimum (1.0), while tail energy falls on 40/40 and 39/40; the floor-breach half of the docstring holds only at comfort_weight 0.05 (13 of 40), outside what comfort_learning can reach. On every d0-grid line (2400, decomp_oracle.py) zeroing the credit moves 1811 plans and lowers tail energy on 1659, and worsens the tail floor breach on 0.
findings.mechanism: The comfort floor is held by the objective's own floor terms (_comfort_terms: squared undershoot x10 plus the L1 term _COMFORT_FLOOR_L1 x comfort_weight), which at any learnable weight (comfort_learning.COMFORT_WEIGHT_MIN..MAX = 1..40) already price a tail undershoot above the energy the credit would save. Removing the credit does dump the last hours (tail kWh 3.6-10.7 -> 0), but the room coasts down without crossing the floor inside the horizon. The docstring states the floor breach as the reason the term exists; a reader (or a fixer weighing a change to the credit) is told the credit guards comfort when it guards only the end-state value.

findings.title: Stress memory channel probes 6 of 54 scenarios: a 2x retained-bytes regression in any of the other 48 passes
findings.claim: With a ballast equal to each scenario's recorded traced peak retained inside HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (a 2x traced regression), the gate's own thresholds flag 54/54 probe readings, but the memory pass only probes the 6 labels _memory_probe_labels selects, so a 2x confined to any of the other 48 scenarios passes green, while the pass's detection check ('budgets tight enough to see a 2x') reports green on multiples computed over all recorded rows.
findings.mechanism: tests/stress.py's memory pass (check mode) probes MEMORY_TOP_N=6 labels chosen from the committed table (3 by traced_peak_mb, 3 by rss_peak_mb); the other rows of stress_budgets.json are never measured in a gate run. The detection-sizing check computes rss/traced threshold multiples (1.5x) over every recorded row and prints them 'over the 6 scenario(s) this pass probes', so it holds the thresholds to DETECTION_TARGET but never the sampling. Corollary from the null arm: on this box's clean tree 9 of the 48 unprobed rows already read 1.6-2.3x their record (their records are never re-read), so the table's unprobed half is unverified.
